tested_use_case: Online Payments — Online payment platforms for accepting cards and wallets, running subscriptions, and moving money at scale. Judged against the ranking's evidence-graded story taxonomy: 54 user stories across 12 themes.
limitations: India (partial): Changed since the 2026-09-28 spike: India now appears on the eligible-countries list ("India IN SINGAPORE"), but the per-location product table covers only the ten local-entity locations, so payments availability for India-registered businesses is onboarding-eligible yet not product-documented.

Brazil (partial): Brazil onboards to the US entity per the eligible-countries list ("Brazil BR UNITED STATES OF AMERICA"); the per-location product table does not document which products, including payment acceptance, a Brazil-registered business receives.

Mexico (partial): Mexico onboards to the US entity per the eligible-countries list ("Mexico MX UNITED STATES OF AMERICA"); the per-location product table does not document which products, including payment acceptance, a Mexico-registered business receives.
